title: A push whose host job was lost mid-write finishes, or can be undone
steps: Run the lost-job cases of tracy-web (TEST_DATABASE_URL) and of live-write.
expect: A lost Apply is started again once with the same push and ends pushed.
An Apply lost twice ends interrupted and stays undoable.
Undo takes back what the journal lists when written.json is missing.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=host job was lost|lost twice|lost before it answered
tests: an Apply whose host job was lost is started again once with the same push id and ends pushed (#122)
an Apply lost twice ends interrupted, and Undo stays offered for what the journal may hold (#122)
Undo after an Apply lost before it answered takes back what its journal lists (#122)
